title: Bigfoot and UFOs: All the weird and wonderful things people are stumbling upon in GTA 6
excerpt: 'Absolute cinema the way it all played out'
content:
GTA 6 is packed full of weird things you just casually stumble upon while playing the game. After GTA day yesterday, it might have all felt a bit like a fever dream, but yes it did happen.

GTA 6 seems to have really put an emphasis on small little oddities, and I’m so here for it. The head of production for Rockstar has previously said they “love” throwing these features in, and do it to surprise the players at every turn.

People have spotted Bigfoot, UFOs, and other strange secrets. For the longest time we’ve wondered why Rockstar throws these things in, but why not?

via Rockstar Games

Bigfoot, UFOs and swimming with manatees

There are a whole bunch of strange creatures, beings and supernatural goings on in GTA 6. One of the main ones people are talking about is The Skunk Ape (also referred to as Mr. Mangrove) – a Bigfoot-style cryptid easter egg and side-quest line. You can find Bigfoot in the wetlands south of Hamlet. 

There are also so, so many animals in the game. There are more than 170 animals in the game, such as alligators and manatees. There are also 62 different species of birds, and players can pull out binoculars and record them all in a logbook. There are iguanas in the streets, and you can swim with manatees. 

Players can also trigger a secret UFO abduction easter egg near Port Gellhorn in Kelly County. The encounter is randomly on a dirt road near the Starlet Motel safehouse east of Port Gellhorn. You need to have Chapter 1 completed, and be after 2am in-game, unlocking the “The Truth Is Out There” trophy or achievement. 

There’s also an X-Men easter egg hiding in plain sight. GTA 6 features 34 collectible magazines and comic book, that you can mostly find in the stores.

You can also casually chuck roadkill at people. “Lmao you can pickup road kill and throw it at people, they must had seen some sh*t when studying Florida for this game,” one person joked. 

One person had a very dark encounter 

A bit more dark and creepy this one. Someone on Twitter shared: “Ok GTA 6 is nuts. I went exploring and swimming in the north of the island and I got taken hostage by a Saw-like character who released me into a Hunger Games-esque arena to be hunted down by people with night-vision goggles and dogs in tactical vests.”

Ok? 

People on Reddit are discussing the weirdest things they’ve found while playing GTA 6

There’s already a Reddit thread discussing some strange things players have found. “What’s the craziest thing you’ve discovered in GTA 6 that most players probably haven’t noticed yet?,” the OP asked.

“Forget the main missions for a minute. I’m talking about the random stuff you stumble across while exploring. Hidden locations, weird NPC behaviour, secret interactions, unexpected encounters or tiny details Rockstar has added that most people would completely miss.

“What’s the most surprising thing you’ve found so far? Try not to spoil any major story moments for people who haven’t got that far yet.”

One person in the replies said: “One of the hotel rooms Lucia walked in was all dark with some creepy monster staring at you and when you look back in it was gone and all the lights were on.”

Another added: “I was driving and saw a plane with smoke pluming out the back. At first thought it was an air show stunt. The smoke became more dense and black and eventually the plane crashed down. I could still see black smoke so I went to investigate. It’s in a field in the middle of nowhere.

“Turns out it was a botched drop. While I’m looting the plane, the intended recipients of the drop show up. We get into a shoot out. Take them out and back to looting the plane, when the cops show up to investigate the crash and reported gunfire. I sneak off before they close in on the scene.

“Absolute cinema the way it all played out. All without any prompts to investigate. Just a subtle cue sparking my curiosity.”

There are also reports of giant fish skeletons, a man filling a bath with petrol before exploding, naked yelling men, and snakes and stacks of cash hidden in trunks.
